notes.title: Skip function is now available!
notes.notes:
You can unlock each level by clicking one button and experience all the content way faster than before.

Immerse yourself in the voice acting, have fun time with girls without breaking a sweat!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40760660/92e9bceb8f6367fcdcd0ea6806a66b3fcb1f2933.png[/img]

notes.title: Skip function is coming very soon!
notes.notes:
We've heard your voices about the ball gameplay being too long and because of that many people are not motivated enough to complete the game, therefore they can't experience all the content.

We are working hard on implementing a skip function to unlock the levels whenever you get tired/bored or just want to hear voice acting/have fun time with girls :3

It should be ready very soon, maybe even in a day or two.

Sorry for the inconvenience!

PS. To the people that like the challenge of playing without the skip function - you still will be able to do that, just don't hit "Unlock level" button ;)

By the way, you can play infinite levels, there is no limit. After you unlock 105 level and get all the achievements, you can reach even 9999 if you are crazy enough!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40760660/92e9bceb8f6367fcdcd0ea6806a66b3fcb1f2933.png[/img]

notes.title: Wild Journey is now available!
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1525460/Wild_Journey/
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36767299/6e6171321b0ec69e4992e6429b7a2b12d26cd439.gif[/img]
Wild Journey is a mature arcade game with dating elements. Experience 3 stages of the relationship: Flirt, Desire and Love. Get to know all the 7 sisters before you become their lover. Unlock 63 various dialogues with English and Japanese voice-over and play unlimited number of bouncing ball levels!

[h2]Features list[/h2]
[list]
    [*] 7 lovely sisters each with unique personalities, appearance and preferences
    [*] 63 diverse lines of dialogues, professionally acted by English and Japanese voice actresses
    [*] unlimited number of bouncing ball levels - rotate the platforms to align the ball with the cracks
    [*] with live2D technology you will be able to move and seduce all the girls - each sister has multiple interactive animations!
    [*] a gorgeously composed soundtrack containing 8 tracks of original music in japanese style
    [*] learn all the deepest secrets and desires of Fuyu, Megumi, Ruri, Aiko, Sayo, Shizuku and Koyuki!
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36767299/31209209da7fce14edf0edce99473d70869de93f.gif[/img]
